p: a man of God out of: That is, a prophet.
Bethel: Not that that was called Luz in Benjamin, but another of that name.
sign which the LORD hath spoken: By this sign you will know that the Lord has sent me.
Lay hold on him: The wicked rage against the prophets of God, when they declare God's judgment to them.
Intreat now the face of the: Though the wicked humble themselves for a time when they feel God's judgment, they return to their old malice and declare that they are but vile hypocrites.
Eat no bread: Seeing he had the express word of God, he should not have declined from it, neither for the persuasion of man nor angel.
Come home with me: This he did of a simple mind, thinking it his duty to declare friendship to a prophet.
angel spake unto me by the: His fault is here double, first in that he did not permit the prophet to obey God's express commandment, and next that he pretended to have a revelation to the contrary.
Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the: God would reprove his folly by him who caused him to err.
a lion met him by the: By this fearful example, God sets forth how dangerous it is for men to behave coldly, or deceitfully in the charge to which God has called them.
not eaten the carcase: To declare that this was only the judgment of God: for if the lion had done it for hunger, he would also have devoured the body.
own grave: Which he had prepared for himself.
returned not from his evil way: So the wicked do not profit by God's threatenings, but go backward and become worse and worse, 2Ti 3:13.
